name: Valendor
storyline: The story revolves around the young Prince Garduran, a member of the royal court of Pargonia and a close confidant of His Majesty. The king recently assigned him a new task - a diplomatic mission to Valendor. The island's ruler, an otherwise always loyal and staunchly pro-king count, unexpectedly broke off contact with the kingdom and ceased paying tribute. Since he also failed to respond to several messages, the king finally dispatched Garduran with a ship and crew to Valendor to investigate the reasons for this unexpected breach of loyalty. Needless to say, things turned out quite differently than initially expected...
summary:
Valendor is a german total conversion mod for Gothic II created by Arthonius.
Features:
- approximately 12-15 hours of gameplay
- three new, detailed game worlds
- well-crafted story whose suspense builds as the game progresses
- high-quality (optional) german voice acting, performed by mostly professional and semi-professional voice actors and actors
- epic soundtrack with nine new music tracks
- new animations, textures, armor, items, weapons, etc.
- new features (cooking, winemaking, drinking barrel, well)
